title: Shimmering Scribble Squid
statement: Residing in a twilight tank of swaying silver kelp and smooth sea-glass pebbles, this curious little cephalopod ripples with bioluminescent curls and squiggles whenever a new thought strikes. Between carefully arranging sunken curiosities into neat constellations on the sand, it drifts up to the glass to flash tiny, glowing question marks at anyone peering in.
